entry.title: Before you enter

here.title: Only people here can see you
here.body: Only the people inside this venue who joined the chat.

adults.title: 18+ only
adults.body: JChat is for adults only. We use automatic filters and review reports; you can report or block anyone.

erased.title: Match is erased when you leave
erased.body: Likes, matches and chats disappear, except with people you both follow.

block.title: Block or report anyone
block.body: From their profile or any message. Nobody knows you did it.

screenshots.title: Screenshots exist
screenshots.body: Nobody can prevent a screenshot. Share with care.

help.title: Something not right?
help.body: Ask the venue staff for help from the app, without anyone else seeing it. In an emergency, call 911.

entry.gamesGlobalHint: Match and Truth or Dare at this venue. Change it anytime in Settings.

visible.title: What others see
visible.i1: Your name, photos, interests and bio.
visible.i2: Never your exact location, your exact age or your contact details.

erased.title: What is erased and what is not
erased.i1: Your Match activity is erased when you leave the venue.
erased.i2: What you write in the venue chat stays visible to everyone.
erased.i3: Reports and blocks are kept to protect the community.

care.title: How to look after yourself
care.i1: Talk on JChat before giving your number or social accounts.
care.i2: Don't share your address, workplace or bank details.
care.i3: Watch your drink and stay in busy areas.
care.i4: Tell a friend who you are with.

wrong.title: If something goes wrong
wrong.i1: Block or report from the profile or the chat.
wrong.i2: "Ask the venue for help" alerts the staff right away.

data.title: Your data
data.i1: Deletion is immediate on JChat; backups are removed automatically within a few days.
data.i2: More details in the Privacy Policy.
